label: 2026-09-14 Google Search Console Pages (index coverage) report, whole property — pre-change baseline for the #192 indexing wave
source: Transcribed from the live Search Console audit recorded on issue #192 on 2026-09-14 (RDC/Chrome). Not exported from the API: no agent on this project holds Search Console credentials, and the report has no CSV of these buckets. Counts prefixed ~ were read as rounded on screen.
note: Established: the bucket counts below and the sitemap URL total the server advertised the same day. NOT established: which URLs sit in each bucket, so the route-family split of the two large buckets is an inference from the sitemap composition (6,867 of 9,852 advertised URLs were sample pages), not a measurement.
